sections.heading: D — Accuracy and Verification
sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and Verification, Section Thirteen Highway driving

Section D records the accuracy posture for the Section Thirteen Highway driving dossier. Every knowledge fact is required to trace to its cited physical handbook page, with the cited page stating the fact. Confidence is high across the section because every rule comes from the single pinned handbook edition, and every number is spelled out in words so that the card backs read aloud exactly. The extracted text of these pages carries a font-encoding shift that garbles scattered words into offset letters; the dossier author decoded the shift deterministically before reading. The DMV's postal addresses, telephone numbers and web addresses are not carried as learner facts, and the accessibility notice that runs across two pages is cited to the page on which each sentence begins. Handbook wording is paraphrased throughout; no official sentence, table, image or question is reproduced. The placard transfer fee is stated as the pinned edition prints it; no time-variable fact beyond that edition appears, so nothing required isolation as dynamic knowledge.

corpus_stability.reason: The West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook is a periodically revised official edition, so the Section Thirteen Highway driving content changes at most with a new edition.
